notes.title: Nemesis Perspective is expanding!
notes.content:
We have been busy with all the work that comes with starting a company, but we are now getting things in order. We are only one-step from having the company set up; we just need to send the paperwork!

We are also now starting to write a dev-blog about the everyday development to keep you updated on where our current project is going. And also talk about game development in general. 

Here's a link to our webpage where you can find the original blog:
http://www.evocatgames.com/

[h1]Direction of the company[/h1]

We have had a lot of thorough discussion on the company's direction, and we all agreed on what we wanted to do from now on. Looking at the current trends in VR, the arcade format is in rise and we are excited to work with the VR-arcade industry closely. However, we want to focus mainly towards the consumer markets directly, because we believe that the home VR-experience is the thing we want to focus on creating.

We are also now working to [b]expand the Nemesis Perspective universe! [/b] Here is some taste for our upcoming content!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27171494/44eeb5312e250bca90593cea9251781ea6457029.png[/img]

Our current plan is to create two new content packs for Nemesis Perspective this year. After that, we will focus on our next production.

[i][b]# Edit #[/b] We were originally planning to bring more content to Nemesis Perspective, but our company got selected for Nordic VR Startups program and we are now working on a brand new game! More on that later, stay tuned! 
In the meanwhile you can read about the NVS program in our blog: http://www.evocatgames.com/wp/blog/news/nordic-vr-startup-announcement/[/i]

[i]-Leevi Paakkonen - Producer, programmer and the official cat picture artist of the Evocat Games team.[/i]

notes.title: System Update 22.12.2016
notes.content:
- Current controller support:
 - Xbox 360
 - Xbox 360 Wireless
 - Xbox One
 - PlayStation 4
 - Steam Controller

Update:
- Tweaked controller support for other manufacturers (such as Logitech, Madcatz etc.) 
- Fixed issues with audio
